tools.name: list_handles
tools.description: List available secret HANDLES (names only — never values) so the model can reference credentials by handle.

tools.name: inject_at_egress
tools.description: Resolve a handle to its secret ONLY at the outbound request boundary of another connector. The secret value is never returned to the model, logged, or stored in memory.

tools.name: rotate
tools.description: Rotate a credential. RED — security change; typed confirmation required.

invariants: Raw secret values NEVER enter prompts, embeddings, logs, audit records, or model-visible tool results.
The model operates on handles; resolution happens inside the broker at egress only.
Every injection is recorded in the audit log by handle + target, never by value.
